name: @violin/mobile
description: Expo (React Native, New Architecture) mobile app for the violin practice project (Finger Tuner + Playing Practice). Phase 4: react-native-audio-api mic capture -> packages/dsp-ts's validated YIN pipeline -> packages/core. Phase 5: a real Finger Tuner UI (note/cents/meter, tri-state no-signal/unclear/reading, vibrato-aware smoothing via packages/core's TunerDisplaySmoother) replacing the old debug panel. Requires a custom dev client (Expo Go cannot load react-native-audio-api's native module) -- see CLAUDE.md.
